title: Blows for the drum, payment for the drummer
odia: ଢୋଲ ଖାଏ ମାଡ ଢୋଲିଆ ଖାଏ କଉଡି।
literal_meaning: The drum takes the blows; the drummer takes the cowries.
meaning_odia: ମାଡ଼ ଖାଉଛି ଢୋଲ, କିନ୍ତୁ କଉଡ଼ି ପାଉଛି ଢୋଲିଆ। ଏଠାରେ କଉଡ଼ିକୁ ପାରିଶ୍ରମିକ ଅର୍ଥରେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, କଷ୍ଟ ବା ଆଘାତ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଭାଗରେ ପଡ଼ୁଥିବାବେଳେ ତାହାର ଲାଭ ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣେ ପାଇବାର ଅମେଳକୁ ଏହି ଚିତ୍ର ଦେଖାଏ।
explanation: The same verb, ଖାଏ, links two very different receipts: blows for the instrument and cowries for the player. Read editorially, the image separates who bears the impact from who receives the proceeds. Its force lies in that unequal allocation.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A team bears the extra work and public criticism for a project while another person claims all the reward. Someone compares the arrangement to blows for the drum and payment for the drummer.
cultural_context: The near-pair ଢୋଲ and ଢୋଲିଆ makes the two participants sound closely connected, while ମାଡ and କଉଡି sharply separate what each receives. Cowries provide the image of payment; the verse supplies no amount.
